newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 7.73 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 7.73 pct.

text.p: Mexico's UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 100.65554 UDIs and a real return of 7.73 percent at the primary auction on Tuesday.
Two weeks ago the UDI bonds had a real return of 7.70 percent.
Demand this week was 1.2 billion UDIs compared to 200 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico with a bid-to-cover ratio of 6.0.
Two weeks ago demand was 758 million UDIs with 150 million on offer and a bid-to-cover ratio of 5.05.
The daily value of the UDI can be found on MXAAN.
